runs.headline: Commit activity on service-6 held steady and evenly spread across four authors; no review data was available to assess
runs.narrative: Over the eight weeks, weekly commits to main stayed in a narrow band, from a low of 21 in the week of 2026-10-12 to a high of 27 in the week of 2026-09-21. Every week had the same four active authors, and in every week it took just 2 of them to account for half of the commits. Over the whole window, alice and dave made 53 commits each, bob 45 and carol 42, so the work was spread fairly evenly. None of the detectors flagged anything unusual, and nothing in the data needs further explanation. Pull request and issue data was not available, so this briefing cannot say anything about review speed, review load or merge throughput.
